reading: Of the 152 free directions (104 with the ghost equation), at least 97 (55 within the ghost-equation subspace) lie in the span of fitted BRST-trivial families (field redefinitions h -> h + F(h,h), c -> c + G(c,h), gauge-fermion change cbar.Phi(h,h)); at most 116 can. The families are only partly closed in N with one uniform lambda (F 65/121, G 11/66, P 12/109): the relative normalisations are FITTED, not derived, and the families are not complete at three points. Remaining >= 36 directions are not shown trivial: 26 hhh-only sigma0-closed evanescent cubic structures (candidate invariant evanescent operators) and blind directions of the three-point rows (69 Kch-only, 12 c*cc-only) constrained only by the ghost equation / four-point rows.
